items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: I know Chuck, somebody wrote the tune from downtown... That was Chuck Cornish. Yeah. Yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, you know, I was singing it because that's on Rick. Yeah, it was on Rick. Okay, and I was trying to think, oh, I know Chuck, somebody wrote the tune from downtown. And I sure don't do that tune, but I might have a copy. That's a good, very well recorded tune. In fact, I got a lot of songs that were well recorded. I got the record right here.
